{{for|the Grothendieck resolution of a reductive algebraic group|Grothendieck–Springer simultaneous resolution}}

In [[mathematics]], a '''Brieskorn–Grothendieck resolution''' is a resolution conjectured by [[Alexander Grothendieck]], that in particular gives a resolution of the universal deformation of a [[Kleinian singularity]].  {{harvs|txt|first=Egbert|last=Brieskorn|authorlink=Egbert Brieskorn|year=1971}} announced the construction of this resolution, and {{harvs|txt|first=Peter|last=Slodowy|authorlink=Peter Slodowy|year=1980}} published the details of Brieskorn's construction.
